verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm GitBook automatically serves a live llms.txt index (both at gitbook.com/llms.txt and per-site at docs/llms.txt) and per-page markdown mirrors (URL+.md) that act as the full-content variant for agent indexing, backed by first-party 'LLM-ready docs' documentation. missing for 10: no confirmation of a single aggregated llms-full.txt file (only per-page .md mirrors), and the root docs.md path itself 404'd.
